cohort: 692 women who underwent VH and 472 who underwent RH for benign uterine disease
finding: Among women with conditions often considered contraindications for vaginal hysterectomy, VH was found to be a safe and feasible option, with comparable outcomes to robotic-assisted hysterectomy in most cases.
mod_finding: This study compared outcomes of vaginal hysterectomy (VH) and robotic-assisted hysterectomy (RH), finding that VH is a viable surgical option for patients with conditions previously perceived as contraindications for vaginal surgery.
